title: PULSEmech compute post-run producer-input capture manifest v0
description: Strict manifest contract for one exact post-run GitHub Actions platform-response snapshot preserved as a non-authoritative producer input. Cross-field, byte, filesystem, pagination, temporal, and subject-binding relations are completed by the separate offline semantic validator.

jobs_page_exchanges.$comment: The offline validator additionally requires strict ascending contiguous page_number order beginning at 1, exact path/query/page agreement, unique exchange IDs, and closure at the final rel=next absence.

contract_bindings.$comment: Observed manifests bind the exact merged PR 1 schema and normative contract repository objects. The manifest does not bind its own final size, digest, Git blob, or containing commit.

run_attempt_response_summary.$comment: Every field is reconstructed independently from the exact preserved run attempt response body and compared with subject.

jobs_page_response_summary.$comment: These declarations are not trusted producer verdicts. The offline validator independently reconstructs jobs, steps, counts, identities, and status/conclusion relations from the exact preserved page body.

run_attempt_exchange.$comment: The separate metadata file is the canonical serialization of record only. metadata_member is held only by the outer manifest, preventing the exchange metadata file from hashing itself.

jobs_page_exchange.$comment: The separate metadata file is the canonical serialization of record only. metadata_member remains outside that record and therefore does not introduce a self-hash.

$comment: The schema closes the stored shape. The separate offline validator must recompute every cross-field, filesystem, byte-identity, pagination, temporal, request, subject, privacy, publication, and authority relation from the preserved members. No capture-tool success declaration is trusted.
